```{r local G calculation functions}
calculate_gi_star <- function(data_group, cell_type) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(data_group)
  immune_counts <- data_group[[cell_type]]
  cell_type_name = substr(cell_type, 5, nchar(cell_type))
  region_id <- data_group$Name

  # Create neighbor matrix
  nb <- dnearneigh(coords, d1 = 0, d2 = 200)

  # Convert neighbor matrix to spatial weights
  weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
  if(!length(immune_counts) >0 ){
    gi_zval <- 0
    gi_pval <- 1
    gi_padj <- 1
  } else{
    # Calculate Gi* statistics
    gi_zval <- as.numeric(localG(immune_counts, weights))
  
    # Calculate p-values
    gi_pval <- format.pval(pnorm(2 * (abs(gi_zval)), lower.tail = FALSE), 2)
    gi_padj <- format.pval(p.adjustSP(pnorm(2 * (abs(gi_zval)), lower.tail = FALSE), nb, "bonferroni"), 2)
  }
  # Combine results into a tibble
  tibble(
    Image = unique(data_group$Image),
    # dataset = unique(data_group$dataset),
    # flow = unique(data_group$flow),
    # pred = unique(data_group$pred),
    # progression = unique(data_group$progression),
    region_id = region_id,
    attention_score = data_group$attention_score,
    !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type_name, "_zval") := gi_zval,
    !!paste0("Gi_", cell_type_name, "_pval") := gi_pval,
    !!paste0("Gi_", cell_type_name, "_padj") := gi_padj
  )
}

# Main function to process the region level data
process_region_level <- function(region_level, cell_type_list) {
  spatial_data <- st_as_sf(region_level %>% filter(Parent == "Image"), coords = c("Centroid.X.um", "Centroid.Y.um"), crs = 3857)
  # if (!dir.exists(output_folder_wsi)) {
  #   dir.create(output_folder_wsi, recursive = TRUE)
  # }
  # write.csv(local_results, file_path, row.names = FALSE)

  wsi_results <- NULL
  for (cell_type in cell_type_list) {
    # Calculate Gi* for the current cell type
  
  # temp_file_path <- file.path(output_folder_wsi, paste0(cell_type, ".csv"))
    gi_results <- spatial_data %>%
      group_by(wsi) %>%
      group_split() %>%  # Split into groups by image
      map_df(~ calculate_gi_star(.x, cell_type))  # Compute Gi* for the cell type

    if (is.null(wsi_results)) {
      wsi_results <- gi_results
    } else {
      wsi_results <- left_join(wsi_results, gi_results, by = c("Image","region_id","attention_score"))
    }
  }


  return(wsi_results)
}
# # Process the region level data for each wsi in parallel
process_single_wsi <- function(wsi, region_level, cell_type_list, output_folder) {
  wsi_data <- region_level %>% filter(wsi == !!wsi)
  print(paste0("Running ", wsi))
  # output_folder_wsi <- file.path(output_folder, wsi)
  data_with_gi <- process_region_level(wsi_data, cell_type_list)
  return(data_with_gi)
}
```

```{ check immune counts}

collect_immune_counts <- function(region_level) {
  # Get unique wsis
  unique_wsis <- unique(region_level$wsi)

  # Function to count cell types for a given wsi
  count_cell_types <- function(wsi_df, wsi_name) {
    cell_type_list <- c("Num.Lymphocyte", "Num.Plasma", "Num.LymphoPlasma", "Num.Immune")

    # Use lapply to count occurrences of each cell type
    cell_counts <- lapply(cell_type_list, function(cell_type) {
      sum(!is.na(wsi_df[[cell_type]]))
    })

    # Set names for the cell counts
    names(cell_counts) <- cell_type_list

    # Create a data frame with the counts
    wsi_cell_counts <- data.frame(
      wsi = wsi_name,
      cell_counts
    )

    # Return the counts as a data frame
    return(wsi_cell_counts)
  }

  # Group by wsi and split into a list of data frames
  grouped_wsi <- region_level %>%
    group_by(wsi) %>%
    group_split()

  # Use future_map to apply the counting function to each wsi in parallel
  cell_counts_list <- future_map(grouped_wsi, function(wsi_df) {
    wsi_name <- unique(wsi_df$wsi)
    count_cell_types(wsi_df, wsi_name)
  })

  # Combine the list of data frames into a single data frame
  counts_df <- bind_rows(cell_counts_list)

  return(counts_df)
}
```

```{r Global functions}
calculate_global_Getis <- function(data_group, cell_type) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(data_group)
  immune_counts <- data_group[[cell_type]]
  cell_type_name = substr(cell_type, 5, nchar(cell_type))
    # Create neighbor matrix
    nb <- dnearneigh(coords, d1 = 0, d2 = 113)
  if(!length(immune_counts) >0 && !length(nb >0)){
    global_g=0
    pval=1
  }else{
    
    # Convert neighbor matrix to spatial weights
    weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "B", zero.policy = T)
    
    # Calculate Gi* statistics
    global_g_df <- globalG.test(immune_counts, weights)
    
    global_g <- global_g_df$estimate[1]
    pval <- global_g_df$p.value
  }
    tibble(
    Image = unique(data_group$Image),  
    # dataset = unique(data_group$dataset),
    # flow = unique(data_group$flow),  
    # pred = unique(data_group$pred),  
    # progression = unique(data_group$progression), 
    !!paste0("GlobalG_", cell_type_name, "_value") := global_g,
    !!paste0("GlobalG_", cell_type_name, "_pval") := pval
  )
  
}

process_global <- function(region_level, cell_type_list) {

  spatial_data <- st_as_sf(region_level, coords = c("Centroid.X.um", "Centroid.Y.um"), crs = 3857)
  cell_type_list <- c("Num.Lymphocyte", "Num.Plasma", "Num.LymphoPlasma", "Num.Immune")
  wsi_results <- NULL

  for (cell_type in cell_type_list) {
    # Use safely to handle errors in calculate_global_Getis
    safe_calculate_global_Getis <- safely(calculate_global_Getis)

    # Calculate Gi* for the current cell type
    globalg_results <- spatial_data %>%
      group_by(wsi) %>%
      group_split() %>%
      map_df(~ {
        result <- safe_calculate_global_Getis(.x, cell_type)
        if (is.null(result$error)) {
          return(result$result)
        } else {
          message("Skipping a group due to error: ", result$error$message)
          return(NULL)
        }
      }) %>%
      bind_rows() %>%
      filter(!is.na(Image))  # Ensure we only keep valid results

    # Add the Gi* results as new columns to the main data frame
    if (is.null(wsi_results)) {
      wsi_results <- globalg_results
    } else {
      wsi_results <- left_join(wsi_results, globalg_results, by = "Image")
    }
  }
  return(wsi_results)
}

process_single_wsi_global <- function(wsi, region_level) {
  tryCatch({
    wsi_data <- region_level %>% filter(wsi == !!wsi)
    data_with_gi <- process_global(wsi_data)
    return(data_with_gi)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error processing wsi ", wsi, ": ", e$message)
    # Return a tibble with the expected structure but with NA values
    return(tibble(Image = as.character(wsi)))
  })
}
```

```{r run global}

global_getis <- data.frame(Image = character())
for (attn_group in c(0,1, 2)) {
  # Filter data based on attention score
  if (attn_group == 0) {
    filtered_data <- region_level_filtered_toSquares %>% filter(attention_score < 0.5)
  } else if (attn_group == 1) {
    filtered_data <- region_level_filtered_toSquares %>% filter(attention_score >= 0.5)
  } else {
    filtered_data <- region_level_filtered_toSquares
  }

  # Process each wsi and collect results
  global_getis_attn <- future_map(
    unique_wsis,
    ~ process_single_wsi_global(.x, filtered_data),
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
    .progress = TRUE
  ) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(., "_attn", attn_group), starts_with("GlobalG_"))

  # Combine results
  if (is.null(global_getis)) {
    global_getis <- global_getis_attn
  } else {
    global_getis <- left_join(global_getis, global_getis_attn, by = "Image")
  }
}

global_getis_df <- global_getis%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  mutate(across(all_of(starts_with("GlobalG_")), ~  replace_na(., 0)))

```
